about_ui.problem_detail: Most navigation apps assume full mobility, hearing, and vision, leaving millions unable to independently plan travel, access sanitary facilities, or decipher critical documents.
about_ui.feat_places_desc: OpenStreetMap navigation with ramps, elevators, cleanliness ratings, and list-first alternatives.
about_ui.feat_assistant_desc: Conversational voice helper, scene obstacle description, and OCR document reading aloud.
about_ui.feat_captions_desc: Browser speech-to-text with adjustable sizing, high-contrast theater view, and .txt export.
about_ui.feat_schemes_desc: Search, filter, plain-language explanation, and quick eligibility matching.
about_ui.feat_sos_desc: 2-second hold safeguard with cancel window that logs GPS and prepares a message for trusted contacts.
about_ui.compliance_desc: Designed for ≥4.5:1 contrast across default, dark, and high-contrast themes, keyboard-only operation, >=44px targets, ARIA live regions, scalable typography, and reduced-motion support.

about.title: About Inclivo
about.tagline: Bridging accessibility gaps through modern, voice-first, and sensory-aware technology.
about.problem_desc: Over 1 billion people worldwide experience disabilities, yet public spaces, transport, and digital information remain riddled with physical and communicative barriers.
about.mission_desc: To provide a unified, accessible-first platform with zero-barrier design, verified mapping, live speech assistive tools, and streamlined welfare access.
